nodes.title: APC PER3 performance file, 11x4.5MR
nodes.where: block 'PROP RPM = 6000', columns J, Ct, Cp (all 30 rows to zero thrust at J 0.545)
nodes.note: APC's own blade-element prediction, not a wind-tunnel test; static values run ~10 % optimistic (K09 REVIEW section 3, J1 REFERENCES). B4 owns the prop data.

nodes.title: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag (1965)
nodes.where: ch. 3: flat plate normal to flow CD 1.17-1.28 by aspect ratio; ch. 2-6 component drag
nodes.note: CD90 1.28 is the value the K09 card and REVIEW used for the hover-lean check; kept for continuity

nodes.title: Helmbold lift slope for low aspect ratio
nodes.where: Raymer, Aircraft Design: A Conceptual Approach, 6th ed., eq. 12.6 (swept form reduces to Helmbold at zero sweep)
nodes.note: a = 2 pi AR / (2 + sqrt(AR^2 + 4)) with a 2-D slope of 2 pi

nodes.title: APC PER3 11x5.5MR rows as copied by B4
nodes.where: team/B4/data/apc_per3_11x55MR.csv, rows rpm = 6000 (19 rows, J 0 to 0.624)
nodes.note: B1 compared every 6 000 rpm row of B4's file with PROP_TABLE on 2026-11-09. APC's blade-element prediction, not a test; B4 owns the prop data

nodes.title: 11x5.5MR Ct and Cp versus J
nodes.text: The fitted prop (APC 11x5.5MR, params propulsion.prop) follows APC's PER3 Ct(J), Cp(J) at 6 000 rpm at every operating point; rows are [J, Ct, Cp]; last row extrapolated to zero thrust
nodes.basis: B4's copy of the APC file; cruise runs at 6 000 rpm (CL-B4-CRUISE-RPM); Re effect between the 5 000 and 7 000 rpm blocks < 1 % on Ct, Cp; the hover-table calibration (CALC-B1-PROPCAL) absorbs APC's static optimism

nodes.title: 11x4.5MR Ct and Cp versus J (calibration reference)
nodes.text: APC PER3 11x4.5MR at 6 000 rpm, rows [J, Ct, Cp]; used only to calibrate the chain to the maker table (11x4.7) and for the 11x5.5MR / 11x4.5MR hover power ratio
nodes.basis: APC data file read 2026-11-09 (rev 1 of this script); the 11x4.5MR is closer in pitch to the maker's 11x4.7 than the 11x5.5MR, so it carries the calibration with less prop error

nodes.title: Zero-lift drag build-up coefficients, non-wing parts
nodes.text: [Cf fin/pod, FF fin, CD motor tube (frontal, faired by the fin), CdA per motor m2, FF pod, interference factor] = [0.0070, 1.20, 0.30, 0.0004, 1.30, 1.15]
nodes.basis: Same coefficients as the K09 card and the K01 card, accepted by the K09 REVIEW (section 4: 'already pessimistic'); turbulent flat plate at Re 3e5 for the paper-faced board and pod; Hoerner for the tube. The wing now uses B2's S5010 section drag (ASM-B1-WING-ROUGH)

nodes.title: Tape-seam factor on the S5010 wing profile drag
nodes.text: The packing-tape wing has 1.10 x the XFOIL Ncrit 9 profile drag that B2's AVL polar carries
nodes.basis: B2 CR-B2-08: S5010 cd at cl 0.47 is 0.0087 (Re 3e5, Ncrit 9) and 0.0096 (Re 2.3e5, Ncrit 5); the ratio 1.10 stands in for early transition at spanwise tape seams. A trip-strip XFOIL run (B2) or the cruise-power test replaces it

nodes.title: Fin brace and station-collar drag
nodes.text: [n braces, brace length m, brace width across the flow m, brace Cd, n collars, collar OD m, collar height m, collar Cd] = [4, 0.15, 0.003, 0.80, 4, 0.026, 0.012, 0.70]; each collar replaces a 12 mm length of faired motor tube (tube Cd from ASM-B1-DRAG is subtracted)
nodes.basis: D3 CR-D3-15 geometry (braces 10 x 3 mm CF strip, 3 mm across the cruise flow, 4 x 0.15 m; collars 26 x 12 mm at |z| 0.148-0.160). Brace: sharp-edged rectangular section l/h 3.3, 2-D Cd ~0.9 (Hoerner ch. 3), x 0.9 for finite length -> 0.80, 0.23 N at 16 m/s, the top of C4's 0.07-0.24 N (CR-C4-08). Collar: short cylinder l/d 0.46 in cross-flow, Cd 0.70 (Hoerner finite cylinder). Slipstream over the braces ignored (cruise thrust per prop < 1 N). ESC pads sit in the existing per-motor CdA

nodes.title: Pressure drag of the pod widening (D-25)
nodes.text: [Cd on the added frontal area, reference pod width m] = [0.20, 0.10]: the 0.14 m pod carries Cd 0.20 on the frontal area (w - 0.10) x h on top of its friction drag in ASM-B1-DRAG
nodes.basis: D-25 (D2 CR-D2-01): +0.0028 m2 frontal, estimated +3 % cruise drag. The friction build-up (Cf FF Swet) of rev 2 was accepted for the 0.10 m pod; the extra 20 mm side channels are blunt-sided box ahead of the wing LE (fineness ~1.5 on 0.14 m), so a forebody/base pressure term is added: Cd 0.20, rounded-edge block of fineness 2-3 (Hoerner ch. 3). With the friction growth the pod adds 0.14 N at 16 m/s (3.4 % of the rev 3 cruise drag) against D-25's 3 % estimate

nodes.title: Pack terminal voltage at full throttle
nodes.text: [fresh, worst state] = [16.0, 13.6] V at the ESC input under full-throttle load
nodes.basis: fresh: 16.8 V full charge less ~0.8 V at 60-100 A on the 6.5 Ah 130C pack; worst state: E2's 20 % charge, 10 degC, 27 mOhm pack under the 100 A limiter (3.4 V/cell, the CR-B1-16 stand point). The ESC passes full duty at full throttle; ESC drop neglected

nodes.title: Flat-plate normal-force coefficient
nodes.text: Wing normal-force coefficient beyond stall CN = CD90 sin(alpha), CD90 = 1.28
nodes.basis: Hoerner flat plate; the value the K09 card used for hover lean, kept so the numbers compare. Low-AR wings with end plates keep more post-stall lift, so this under-predicts lift in transition (conservative)

nodes.title: ESC efficiency
nodes.text: ESC efficiency 0.95 in hover and cruise
nodes.basis: K09 card value; BLHeli_S at 7-30 A

nodes.title: Avionics and servo power
nodes.text: FC, GPS, receiver, telemetry, airspeed sensor and two elevon servos draw 6 W together
nodes.basis: card 5 W + 1 W for the two servos

nodes.title: Cruise trim drag factor
nodes.text: Trim adds 2 % to cruise drag on top of B2's trimmed wing polar
nodes.basis: B2's polar (P:b2.avl.e_oswald, cd0_wing) is already trimmed, elevon profile drag included; B3 finds +0.2 % induced trim drag at 16 m/s (CR-B3-07). The 2 % left covers the up-trimmed elevon gap and pod/fin junctions. Was 1.05 (K09 card) before B2/B3 answered

nodes.title: Proposed cruise airspeed 16 m/s
nodes.text: B1 proposes AIRSPEED_CRUISE = 16 m/s (params.json#performance.cruise_ms, CHANGE-LOG D-01)
nodes.basis: lowest whole-number speed above 1.3 Vs at the 2.6 kg gate with B2's trimmed CLmax 0.80 on the c 0.32 wing (15.43 m/s, CL-B1-VT-GATE); +3.7 %, about 0.6 m/s for airspeed-hold and sensor error (R-AIRSPEED-ERR allows 1 m/s, so the margin is thin)

nodes.title: Pessimistic-case factors
nodes.text: [CD0 factor, prop efficiency factor, hover power factor] = [1.30, 0.85, 1.10]; the pessimistic case also uses params wing.oswald_e (0.80) in place of B2's 0.93
nodes.basis: CD0 x 1.3 as the K09 REVIEW pessimistic case; prop efficiency 15 % below APC (BEMT optimism, tractor prop ahead of a fin and tube); hover +10 % for APC static optimism and the 11x4.7 maker table (400 W x 1.10 = 440 W, E2's pessimistic 29.9 A x 14.8 V = 443 W)

nodes.title: Thrust kept for attitude control
nodes.text: Steady flight may use at most 80 % of available thrust (sagged pack); 20 % stays for control
nodes.basis: common multirotor practice (hover throttle <= 50-60 %, never saturate in steady state); a tailsitter controls pitch in hover and transition by differential thrust only

nodes.title: Landing attitude error
nodes.text: Attitude error at touchdown, on top of the steady wind lean, is 10 deg
nodes.basis: first-order allowance for gusts and controller error in QLAND; C5 and H2 refine from the twin's logs

nodes.title: Pitch-over schedule
nodes.text: [pitch rate deg/s, assist speed as a fraction of Vs, back-transition energy as a fraction of the forward pitch-over] = [12, 1.10, 1.0]
nodes.basis: Rev 3 (sag 0.76, D-35): 12 deg/s gives a peak of 0.70 of available thrust in CALC-B1-PITCHOVER on the worst-state pack; 14 gives 0.75, 15 gives 0.77, 16 gives 0.79 and 20 gives 0.88 (performance_results.json#sensitivity). 16 deg/s is now the fastest whole-number rate that keeps <= 0.80, but with no margin while the sag is UNVERIFIED (E1 0.854, E2 0.76; the cold-pack stand run decides), so 12 deg/s stays the first-flight Q_TAILSIT_RAT_FW (rev 2 derived it at sag 0.72, peak 0.76). On a fresh pack 20 deg/s gives 0.59. Thrust holds altitude below 1.1 Vs (Q_ASSIST_SPEED analogue); the back-transition is a pitch-up deceleration of similar length at similar thrust

nodes.title: Aero model: CD0, k, lift slope, stall angle
nodes.equation: CD0 = IF [CD0_wing,B2 f_rough + Cf FF Swet_fins + Cd_tube d L + n CdA_motor + Cf FF Swet_pod + Cd_front (w - w_ref) h + n_b Cd_b w_b l_b + n_c (Cd_c D_c - Cd_tube d) h_c] / S, Swet_fin = 2 A (1 + 0.2 t/c) ; k = 1/(pi AR e_B2) ; k_pess = 1/(pi AR e_params) ; a = CLa (B2 AVL) ; alpha_s = alpha0 + CLmax/a ; L/D max = 1/(2 sqrt(CD0 k))

nodes.title: Stall and transition speeds
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2 m g/(rho S CLmax)) ; Vt = 1.3 Vs ; Vs30 = Vs/sqrt(cos 30) ; margin = Vcruise/Vt - 1

nodes.title: Prop and motor chain, calibrated to the maker table
nodes.equation: n_max = sqrt(T0/(Ct0 rho D^4)) (11x5.5MR) ; n_max,sag = n_max sqrt(sag) ; k_cal = P_table(690 gf) / P_motor(11x4.5MR model at 690 gf, J = 0) ; FM = T^1.5/(sqrt(2 rho A) P_shaft) (11x5.5MR)

nodes.title: Hover power, current, endurance and thrust headroom
nodes.equation: T_motor = m DL / n ; r = P_motor(11x5.5MR, T) / P_motor(11x4.5MR, T) ; P = n P_table(T_motor) r / eta_esc + P_av ; I = P / V ; t_hover = E (1 - reserve) / P ; throttle = m g DL / (n T_max sag)

nodes.title: Cruise at the proposed speed, gate mass
nodes.equation: CL = 2W/(rho V^2 S) ; D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim ; prop: Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 = D/n ; P_el = n k_cal P_motor(Cp rho n^3 D^5) / eta_esc + P_av ; eta_drive = P_shaft / (P_el - P_av) ; pess: CD0 x 1.3, k_pess (e 0.80), eta_prop x 0.85

nodes.title: Cruise power and cruise time versus airspeed
nodes.equation: for V in 14..20 m/s: P_el(V) as CALC-B1-CRUISE ; t = (E(1-res) - P_h t_h - 2 E_tr)/P_el ; pess: P_h and E_tr x 1.10 and the pessimistic P_el

nodes.title: Mission energy: 2 min hover, two transitions, cruise
nodes.equation: E_use = E (1 - reserve) ; E_c = E_use - P_hover t_hover - E_tr (1 + back) ; t_cruise = E_c / P_cruise ; range = t_cruise V ; pess: P_hover and E_tr x 1.10, P_cruise,pess ; cross-check with B1 hover

nodes.title: Transition corridor, steady level flight
nodes.equation: for V in 0..22 m/s: T cos(th) = D(a=th), T sin(th) + L = W ; corridor th_lo..th_eq with T = (W - L)/sin(th) <= f T_max(V cos a) ; P_el at T/n ; peaks taken over 0 <= V <= Vcruise

nodes.title: Forward transition (pitch-over) time simulation
nodes.equation: m dv/dt = T(th) + L + D - W (2-D point mass, dt 0.01 s, semi-implicit Euler) ; th_cmd = max(90 - r t, th_req(V)) ; T holds altitude below V_assist, speed above

nodes.title: Hover lean, wind limits, landing and ground tip-over
nodes.equation: lean = atan(0.5 rho V^2 S CD90 / W) ; lean_allowed = tipover - err ; V_hover,max: lean = lean_allowed ; T/W at 8 m/s = 1/cos(lean) ; V_ground,tip = sqrt(2 m_min g z_fin / (h_cp rho S CD90)), h_cp = c/2 + foot

nodes.title: Vertical climb, fixed-wing climb and top speed
nodes.equation: VTOL: T = W DL + q S_front CD0 at Vc, prop at J = Vc/(nD) ; full throttle at V: n = min(n_V, n_I, n_cap) from V_term = n 60/Kv + I Rm, I = Q/kt + I0 <= I_lim ; T = n_props Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 ; FW: ROC = (f T(V) - D) V / W (worst pack) ; V_max: T(V) = D(V) ; V_H at the rpm cap, fresh pack, base drag ; V_max,sag worst pack ; pitch speed = p n_cap
